title: Telepathic contact with the orb 'Sylvia'
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: fractalizing type energy. And in one of the experiences, it was telling me that his name was Sylvia.

plain: Between 2008 and 2010, at a place called Baker Victory Services in Western New York, an orb made contact with Jordan Jose by telepathy, meaning without speech, mind to mind, and in one of those experiences said its name was Sylvia. Jose tells Michels this as something he lived through himself. He describes the orb as a 'fractalizing type energy', and if his account is true, an intelligence of some kind spoke to him directly and gave itself a name.
